tools.name: search_providers
tools.description:
Search NDIS providers by head office location and/or service category.

Location filters match the provider's head office, not individual outlets —
outlet addresses are inconsistently populated in the source register (~54%),
so head office is the more reliable location signal for Phase 0.

Args:

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: Get the full record for a single provider by its ABN (provider_id).

tools.name: list_service_categories
tools.description: List the valid NDIS service category values usable in search_providers().

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "search_providers" is 732 chars, far longer than this server's median (73). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
